d`).\n- [Resolve or create a file-owned eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/resolve-or-create-a-file-owned
-eval-suite.md): Resolve a file-owned suite by declared id within the project, or create one. Lookup is by `(projectId, declaredSu
iteId)` and never by name. A UI-authored suite has no declared id and cannot be claimed. The inspector parses the suite file; this
body is the declared identity, source hash, optional pro…\n- [Get one eval suite's configuration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-ref
erence/eval-runs/get-one-eval-suites-configuration.md): The suite's full settings — attached environments, hosts, execution config
, judge, schedule. The list route returns run rollups instead; this is the shape the edit routes read and write.\n- [Delete an eva
l suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-suite.md): Deletes the suite and its cases. Past runs are
not deleted.\n- [Update an eval suite's settings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-suites-settings.m
d): Partial update — omitted fields are left as they are. `environmentIds` is tri-state: a non-empty array sets/replaces, `null` c
lears (reverting the suite to legacy config), and `[]` is rejected rather than silently treated as a clear. Responds with the full
updated suite.\n- [Get the pre-run disclosure for a suite launch plan](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-the-pr
e-run-disclosure-for-a-suite-launch-plan.md): What happens to a run's content BEFORE you launch it: which models it calls and wher
e they route, which LLM analyzers/judges can fire and where their evidence goes, capture/retention/region facts, and the subproces
sors engaged. Read-only — never launches or gates a run. Keyed by the SAME destination…\n- [List a suite's eval cases](https://doc
s.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-eval-cases.md): Every case in the suite, in the public steps-first shape.\n- [C
reate an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-case.md): Adds one case to the suite. Both `tit
le` and a non-empty `steps` array are required — `steps` is optional on the shared case shape so PATCH can be partial, but a case
persisted without executable steps could never run. When `models` is omitted the suite's configured model is used.\n- [Create seve
ral eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-several-eval-cases.md): Adds up to 100 cases to the suite i
n one call — the bulk form of the single create, and the way to import a suite or convert a repo's test files without a round trip
per case. Every entry needs a `title` and a non-empty `steps` array. Cases are validated together and reported individually: a `f
ailed…\n- [Generate eval cases from the suite's tools](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/generate-eval-cases-from-th
e-suites-tools.md): Discovers the suite's server tools over a live MCP connection, generates cases against them, and persists them
— the only edit route that connects to a server. Synchronous: connect, generate, persist, disconnect, respond.\n- [Author eval ca
ses from a document](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/author-eval-cases-from-a-document.md): The sibling of `cases/
generate`: generation invents cases from the suite's tools, import reads them out of something a person already wrote — a test pla
n, a spreadsheet of scenarios, a JSON export. MCPJam's own model turns the document into full cases (ordered steps, tool calls, as
sertions), so the…\n- [Read an eval authoring job](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/read-an-eval-authoring-job.md):
Progress and drafts for a job started by `cases/generate` or `cases/import`. Poll this after a `202`, then commit the job once it
s `status` is `completed`.\n- [Write a finished authoring job's cases into the suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-r
uns/write-a-finished-authoring-jobs-cases-into-the-suite.md): Writes the job's drafts into the suite. A draft carrying unresolved
blocking issues or proposed additions is **skipped** rather than written, and comes back under `skipped` with a `reviewUrl` for fi
nishing it in the app.\n- [Get one eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-case.md): A case that b
elongs to this suite and project. A case in another suite is a 404, not a 403.\n- [Delete an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/ap
i-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-case.md): Removes the case from the suite. Past runs that executed it are not affected.\n- [U
pdate an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-case.md): Partial update — omitted fields are l
eft as they are. Supplying `steps` REPLACES the case's definition rather than merging into it. `matchOptions` and `checks` accept
`null` to clear the case-level override and fall back to the suite's.\n- [Upload a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refer
ence/eval-runs/upload-a-run-artifact.md): Stores one artifact referenced by an ingested run (typically widget HTML too large to se
nd inline) and returns the `storageId` the run's results then reference. This is what `reportEvalResults` in `@mcpjam/sdk` uses fo
r widget evidence.\n- [Get an upload URL for a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-upload-url-for
-a-run-artifact.md): Retired. Every request answers `410 Gone` with `code: \"FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED\"` and `details.code: \"SDK_UPG
RADE_REQUIRED\"`. `@mcpjam/sdk` 8.17.0 and later upload a run artifact by sending its bytes to `POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-in
gest/artifacts`, which returns the `storageId` the run's results…\n- [Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities](https://
docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/discover-authenticated-eval-ingestion-capabilities.md): Discover authenticated eval ingest
ion capabilities. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabi
lities remain absent.\n- [Persist advisory case-run evaluations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/persist-advisory-
case-run-evaluations.md): Persist advisory case-run evaluations. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project auth
orization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.\n- [Ingest a completed eval run in one call](https://docs.mcp
jam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/ingest-a-completed-eval-run-in-one-call.md): The whole-run variant: submit a finished run and its
iterations in a single request. This is what the SDK reporter uses by default.\n- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSI
DE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authe
nticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).\n- [Revoke a model lease](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/e
val-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md): Kills this caller's SDK model leases under `runId` in the addressed project, immediately — the
proxy fails a revoked lease closed from that moment. Leases also expire on their own, so this is for ending a run early (an SDK su
ite calls it at teardown) rather than something a caller must do.\n- [Close an open ingestion run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-ref
erence/eval-runs/close-an-open-ingestion-run.md): Marks the run complete and computes its rollups. Until this is called the run st
ays open in the dashboard.\n- [Append iterations to an open run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/append-iterations
-to-an-open-run.md): Appends one batch of iteration results to a run opened by `runs/start`.\n- [Authenticate and record an eval s
tart](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-eval-start.md): Called by official SDK, CLI and V
itest runners before executing an eval. Requires an organization API key or saved-login bearer. Records only start metadata, creat
es no dashboard run, and applies no debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are intent, not completed usage. Reuse the runStartId
for ret…\n- [Open a run for incremental ingestion](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/open-a-run-for-incremental-inge
stion.md): Opens a run that iterations are appended to, for a long CI job that reports as it goes. Pair with `runs/iterations` and
